name: Exelon
summary: Exelon appears in Part 13 of The Buildout. Part 13: The Ratepayer Pays First.

mentions.section: The bill no state can shield
mentions.excerpt: The Indicated PJM Transmission Owners, in a rehearing request Exelon filed with FERC on January 16, said a co-located load that funds its own upgrades but pays nothing toward the existing grid leaves other customers holding the bag.
